title: Backlog tool holds its own rules
goal: backlog.py close leaves no dangling relates_to, done counts work committed under an item's tasks, horizon reports an approved planned sprint as waiting on start, new writes an active sprint's item as todo, start refuses a work item without touches, and the failure fingerprint reads the test id behind GitLab's timestamp and stream marker

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
